methodology.primary: Playwright Request.timing().responseEnd (milliseconds) and matched Railway durationMs; request IDs join browser and server evidence.
methodology.pageWait: Derived per navigation: first API start to last API response end before next navigation. Not Web Vitals, CPU time, p95 or field RUM.
methodology.excluded: Automation ready probes can resolve early during intermediate empty states or late due static 'Đang mở' text. Do not treat raw mark.ms as definitive rendered-ready latency; 30s profile result invalid. First guest failure occurred during heavy main-thread stalls and is retained separately.
methodology.residual: clientMs minus backendMs includes browser/network/edge/proxy/transport; not all frontend CPU or Vercel processing.
methodology.otherTraffic: Only exact audit request IDs retained from shared deployment logs.
